strings.subtitle: — Mũnyamũri wa faili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kũhũthĩra na kũrekereria gũtirĩ. Hũthĩra kĩbato kĩrĩ thĩ.
strings.shred_button: N Y A M Ũ R A
strings.ssd_warning:
Kĩrathimo! Kũrĩ SSD, njĩra ya kwandĩka igũrũ ndĩrĩ kĩhooto kĩa kũnyamũra nĩ ũndũ wa TRIM.
Mũbango ũyũ nĩ wa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faili "{name}" nĩĩkũandĩkwo igũrũ na nĩĩkũnyamũrwo.

Ũkĩrĩte?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAILI NĨ YAANDĨKIRWO IGŨRŨ NA NĨ YANYAMŨRIRWO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mĩrĩngo ya ũhoro ĩngĩ (ADS) ndĩrĩ kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
• Ibuku rĩa USN ndĩrĩ kũthambirwo.
• Ithandũkũ cia kĩĩni na kũhũthĩra kwa matu
  (OneDrive na ingĩ) ndĩrĩ kũhũthĩrwo.
strings.step_delete: Gũthambiria na kũhĩtũka nyũngũ ya thĩ
strings.status_full: Ihinda rĩothe rĩaandĩkirwo igũrũ na uthiru. Kũruta ndĩngĩhota — indo itona uthiru o rĩmwe.
strings.status_fast: Kĩongo, mũthia na mĩrĩngo 4 MB nĩ yaandĩkirwo igũrũ. Gĩcunjĩ gĩothe gĩtirĩ kũhũthĩrwo, ĩndĩ nĩ ũndũ wa itina, kũruta gĩcunjĩ gĩothe na indo cia arĩa angĩ ndĩngĩhota. Kũrĩ rĩandĩko rĩa hitho, hũthĩra mũbango MWIYU.
strings.status_empty: Faili yarĩ ndĩ na kĩndũ, kwandĩka igũrũ kwatirĩ gũkena. Nĩ yanyamũrirwo.
strings.error_permission: Ndĩngĩhota kũgĩa na ũhoro wa faili. Nĩ ingĩhota gũkorwo nĩ yahingũrwo harĩ mũbango ũngĩ. Hingĩra na ugerie rĩngĩ.
strings.error_not_found: Faili ndĩonekire. Nĩ ingĩhota gũkorwo nĩ yanyamũrirwo tene.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ĩno nĩ kĩhũngĩro kĩa kĩoneki. Ihũngĩro ndĩrĩ kũnyamũrwo — faili ĩrĩa ĩrĩ bũrũri nĩĩkũigĩrĩra wega.
strings.error_reparse: Ĩno nĩ faili ya handũ (OneDrive kana ingĩ). Ũhoro wayo ũrĩ matu-inĩ, tondũ wa disiki — gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩa kũnyamũra harĩ.
strings.error_not_file: Ĩno ti faili (folda kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ). Rekereria faili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faili ĩno ĩrĩ na ihũngĩro ingĩ nene ({n} ciothe). Ihũngĩro nene itirĩ na mũnene — rĩitwa rĩothe rĩrĩ rĩmwe. Ũngĩnyamũra na njĩra ya rĩu, ũhoro nĩũkũandĩkwo igũrũ na ũteme nginya 32 byte, ĩndĩ mũthia nĩũkũgĩa na ũhoro na ihũngĩro ingĩ. Thambiria ihũngĩro ciothe mbere.
strings.error_compressed:
Faili nĩ yahinyirirwo, nĩ yahethirwo kana nĩ nini. Kwandĩka igũrũ na uthiru ndĩrĩ kĩhooto kĩa kũnyamũra ũhoro wa tene nĩ ũndũ NTFS wĩigĩrĩra na njĩra ĩngĩ.

Ruta kĩmenyithia: hũthĩra rũhĩ rwa ũrĩo → Ũmenyithia → Mbere → ruta kĩmenyithia kĩa "Hinya" na/kana "Hitha". Rĩngĩ rĩu hũthĩra SHREDDER.
